prs.title: Limit MCP product attribution to configured REPL-backed calls
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Limit MCP product attribution to configured REPL-backed calls

## Why

MCP request metadata could forward a client-supplied `product_sku` to unrelated servers and connectors.

## What changed

Remove `product_sku` from turn metadata before forwarding it. For Node REPL-backed servers and the browser connector, populate it from the turn's `apps_mcp_product_sku` configuration, mapping unrecognized values to `other` and omitting empty or missing values.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for configured REPL and browser attribution, unrelated servers and connectors, unrecognized or absent configuration, and spoofed client metadata.

prs.title: Finalize aborted turns and ignore unrelated late aborts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Finalize aborted turns and ignore unrelated late aborts

## Why

An aborted turn could remain active, and a late abort for an unknown turn could interrupt a different turn with an explicit ID.

## What changed

Finalize the active turn after applying an abort. Only fall back to the active turn when the abort lacks a turn ID or the active turn has a generated ID.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage to verify that a late abort preserves a review turn's ID and completed status, and that repeating `turn/interrupt` returns `no active turn to interrupt`.

prs.title: Centralize permission config selection and legacy translation
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Centralize permission config selection and legacy translation

## What changed

Move permission selection into `codex-config` with a shared `PermissionConfig` representation for legacy sandbox settings and named profiles. Resolve selectors using config layer precedence while preserving explicit session profile selection and sandbox mode overrides.

Share legacy permission translation between config derivation and core loading, preserving merged workspace roots, network access, temporary-directory exclusions, and platform sandbox availability without modifying source layers or field origins.

## Testing

Add coverage for mixed selector precedence, merged legacy settings, unchanged source metadata, and the Windows read-only fallback. Extend the managed preferences loader test to verify settings merged across layers and the absence of an active named profile for legacy permissions.

prs.title: Canonicalize Windows sandbox homes and migrate saved junction paths
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Canonicalize Windows sandbox homes and migrate saved junction paths

## What changed

- Canonicalize home paths before sending sandbox provisioning and desktop registration requests.
- Resolve saved junction paths when restoring the sandbox owner, holding the setup lock and pinning target directories while validating existing sandbox accounts. Skip migration for retiring runtimes.
- Persist the resolved home and clear desktop home ownership so uninstall cannot delete a historical junction's target.

## Testing

Add a Windows junction test verifying that a saved alias resolves to its physical target and an already canonical path needs no migration.

prs.title: Gate plugin recommendation cache warming on feature flags
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Gate plugin recommendation cache warming on feature flags

## Why

Background plugin cache refreshes fetched recommendations even when plugin recommendations were disabled.

## What changed

Pass the effective recommendation feature state into `PluginsConfigInput` and skip recommendation cache warming unless apps, plugins, and either `tool_suggest` or `recommended_plugins` are enabled. Installed-plugin cache refreshes continue independently.

Disable `tool_suggest` and `recommended_plugins` by default in core and app-server test helpers, with explicit overrides for recommendation tests.

## Testing

Update cache-warming and external-login recommendation tests to opt in explicitly. Update config RPC assertions to verify the test helpers' session flag overrides.

prs.title: Apply session app overrides during MCP config refresh
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Apply session app overrides during MCP config refresh

## Why

MCP config refreshes previously retained session app overrides, leaving connector approval changes unapplied in existing sessions.

## What changed

- Refresh explicit session `apps` overrides alongside `plugins`, allowing updated link approval settings to take effect on the next turn.
- Preserve overrides for omitted sections and restore inheritance when a section is an empty table.
- Validate app overrides and the effective app configuration, rejecting refreshes that expose invalid inherited settings.

## Testing

Add coverage for independent and combined app/plugin updates, clearing overrides, and rejecting invalid inherited app settings. Add an integration test verifying that changing a link's approval mode from `approve` to `prompt` requests approval before executing the next turn's tool call.

prs.title: Allow model-facing ID sequences to resume from allocated IDs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow model-facing ID sequences to resume from allocated IDs

## Why

Resuming an ID sequence from a persisted ID requires its allocation position before shuffling. Previously, IDs stored only their salt and shuffled value.

## What changed

- Store the allocation `ordinal` in `ModelFacingId`, expose `salt()` and `ordinal()`, and derive `JsonSchema`.
- Add `ModelFacingIdGenerator::starting_at()` and `next_ordinal()` so callers can resume with the original seed and salt at the next allocation position without a generator snapshot.

## Testing

Update serialization coverage for the allocation fields and add a test that resumes from a serialized ID across the three-digit pool boundary, matching the uninterrupted sequence.

prs.title: Preserve file-backed audio in tool outputs
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve file-backed audio in tool outputs

## Why

Converting message content to tool output previously reduced file-backed audio to a text file ID, losing its audio type.

## What changed

- Allow `input_audio` tool output items to carry either `audio_url` or `file_id`, preserving both forms during content conversion.
- Account for file-backed tool audio in history estimates and output truncation, and prepare only inline audio data.
- Reject uploaded audio in raw function and custom tool output injection, extending the existing requirement to submit uploaded audio through typed turn input.
- Regenerate app-server schemas and TypeScript/Python types while preserving the Python inline audio class name.

## Testing

Add coverage for tool audio wire-format round trips, repeated file audio sharing text and audio output budgets, and rejection of raw uploaded audio injection across messages and tool outputs. Extend Python SDK coverage for the inline tool audio shape.

prs.title: Add a Git credential helper for existing Codex logins
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add a Git credential helper for existing Codex logins

## What changed

Add the hidden `codex git-credential` command to supply an existing file-backed ChatGPT login as an ephemeral Bearer credential through Git's `authtype` protocol.

Restrict credentials to HTTPS requests under `backend-api/codex/sites/git/` on `chatgpt.com` or `chatgpt-staging.com`, matching the configured origin. Check managed workspace policy and reject expired or changed logins before returning credentials. Ignore repository configuration when selecting authentication settings.

The helper does not refresh tokens or modify the saved login; `store` and `erase` are no-ops. Return `quit=true` when authentication is unavailable or fails so Git does not fall back to prompting.

## Testing

Add coverage for capability advertisement before login, reading only the first credential record, and declining personal access tokens without an authentication API lookup.

prs.title: Label seed arguments in the model-facing ID recovery test
Capture saved Daybreak preferences for native helpers
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Capture saved Daybreak preferences for native helpers

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `daybreak_program_propagation` feature to capture a parent's saved Daybreak choice when spawning native helpers. Retain the choice and account identity for helper turns and nested spawns, while preserving explicit `cyber_access_program` overrides. A helper's own saved preference takes precedence on later turns.

Read pending metadata before persisted metadata so preferences survive thread materialization, with stored choices taking precedence. Share this resolution logic with `thread/read` and support refreshing the feature through user configuration.

## Testing

Add coverage for saved and pending preferences, unset choices, explicit overrides, failed metadata reads, nested spawns, parent unloading, feature withdrawal, and preference changes between helper turns.

prs.title: Add snapshot coverage for history and notes tool contracts
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add snapshot coverage for history and notes tool contracts

## What changed

Add a `bundled_tool_contracts` test that snapshots the serialized default tool specifications for all nine history and notes actions. Include the snapshot files in Bazel test data.

prs.title: Use typed context window IDs throughout thread persistence
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Use typed context window IDs throughout thread persistence

## What changed

Carry `ContextWindowId` through session metadata, compaction checkpoints, rollout recording, and thread creation instead of converting IDs to strings. Add deserialization and JSON schema support while preserving the serialized string format and legacy numeric compaction IDs.

Validate deserialized IDs as UUIDv7 values before restoring context windows, preserving the existing handling of unsupported IDs.

prs.title: Fix Unicode caseless matching in thread search
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix Unicode caseless matching in thread search

## Why

Lowercasing alone misses caseless matches such as Greek sigma variants and `ss` matching `ß` in `thread/searchOccurrences`.

## What changed

Use Unicode default case folding after lowercasing both search terms and text. Map folded matches back to source character boundaries so snippets highlight the original text correctly, including characters that expand during folding.

## Testing

Extend the app-server search integration test to cover sigma variants, `ss` matching `ß`, newer Unicode case mappings, and UTF-16 match ranges in text containing an emoji.

prs.title: Hand off approved plans through attachments in fresh sessions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Hand off approved plans through attachments in fresh sessions

## What changed

Make “Yes, clear context and implement” save the approved plan as an app-server attachment and submit a short prompt referencing it. Add the experimental `thread/prepareApprovedPlan` request to verify that the fresh thread's executor can read the file and that its contents match the approved plan.

If the attachment cannot be written or read, inject the complete plan as `proposed_plan` tool output within the model's context and truncation limits. If the complete plan cannot fit, report an error and keep the current session. Clear the UI and switch threads only after plan preparation succeeds.

## Testing

Add TUI tests covering a large plan read from its attachment, complete fallback context when attachment writes or reads fail, and preservation of the original session when the fallback is too large. Snapshot the fresh thread's initial request.

prs.title: Derive history and notes tool schemas from typed requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Derive history and notes tool schemas from typed requests

## What changed

Replace handwritten JSON schemas with Rust request types using `serde` and
`schemars`. Derive tool descriptions from doc comments and retain explicit
nullability, numeric bounds, enum values, and `encrypted` annotations.

Keep forwarding the original JSON arguments to the HTTP backend so catalog
parameters can evolve independently of the request types.

prs.title: Preserve model-facing ID allocations in saved history
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve model-facing ID allocations in saved history

## Why

Restoring model-facing ID sequences requires allocation ordinals alongside the rendered IDs. Responses API payloads still require string IDs.

## What changed

- Add allocation metadata to `ResponseItemId` while keeping equality, hashing, and ordering based on the rendered ID.
- Preserve optional `id_allocation` metadata in rollout items, inter-agent messages, compaction replacement history, and Guardian checkpoints. Continue accepting legacy string IDs.
- Support structured context-window allocations alongside UUIDv7 strings, validate the `window` salt on restoration, and keep request metadata IDs as strings.

## Testing

Add tests for allocation round trips, legacy ID compatibility, string-only raw response item IDs, and context-window allocation validation.

prs.title: Resolve saved Daybreak choices for each subagent turn
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Resolve saved Daybreak choices for each subagent turn

## Why

A subagent can use a different model from its parent, with different supported access programs. Saved Daybreak choices need to resolve against the subagent's model and remain consistent throughout its turn, including compaction.

## What changed

- Resolve saved choices before native subagent turns start, preserving explicit turn overrides and applying saved toggles on later turns.
- Distinguish inherited parent programs from explicit child selections. Adapt inherited Daybreak Blue/Red selections to the child model while retaining the saved choice as the default for later turns and nested subagents.
- Validate the account associated with automatic selections and reject incompatible saved choices before sending model requests, while retaining rejected user input in conversation history.
- Require model changes to wait until the next turn when a saved Daybreak choice is present.

## Testing

Add coverage for both multi-agent spawn versions, model-specific selection, automatic compaction, WebSocket response reuse, account changes, unsupported choices, and rejected-input persistence across resume.

prs.title: Centralize synchronous Guardian reviewer selection
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Centralize synchronous Guardian reviewer selection

Share reviewer lookup and deferred configuration resolution through
`select_synchronous_reviewer` in isolated assessments and approval reviews.
Keep configuration resolution within each caller's review deadline.

prs.title: Preserve retained assistant revisions across rollout replay
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve retained assistant revisions across rollout replay

## Why

Replaying delivered assistant messages allocates new retained-source revisions instead of preserving those captured in live history.

## What changed

- Capture retained sources when recording assistant deliveries, persist them in rollout metadata, and reuse their revisions during replay.
- Add optional `next_item_ordinal` compaction metadata and a `next_model_id_ordinals` helper to recover item and window allocation positions from checkpoints and subsequent records. Ignore allocation metadata that refers to other threads.

## Testing

Extend tests to compare live and replayed delivery sources, preserve revisions through an older reader's rewrite, and verify ordinal recovery from checkpoints and subsequent local items.

prs.title: Fall back to HTTP immediately for oversized WebSocket requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fall back to HTTP immediately for oversized WebSocket requests

## Why

A WebSocket close with code `1009` before any text arrives indicates that the request exceeds the peer's message size limit. Retrying the request over another WebSocket does not address that limit.

## What changed

- Classify these early size rejections as requiring HTTP fallback and switch transports without exhausting WebSocket retries, including during prewarming.
- Preserve ordinary stream retry behavior for size closes after any text frame and for other close codes.

## Testing

Add integration coverage for early size rejections during generation and prewarming, size closes after metadata, rate limits, or response creation, and ordinary closes.

prs.title: Honor advertised WebSocket message size limits
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Honor advertised WebSocket message size limits

## Why

Requests that exceed the server's advertised WebSocket message size limit can fall back to HTTP without first uploading the oversized message.

## What changed

Read `x-codex-websocket-max-message-bytes` from the handshake response and check the serialized request's byte length before sending. Route oversized requests through the existing HTTP fallback. Ignore missing or invalid limits, and remove the close-code-specific wording from the size-limit error.

## Testing

Add a fallback test that advertises a one-byte limit and verifies zero WebSocket generation requests and one HTTP request.

prs.title: Make TUI thread titles resilient to generation failures
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Make TUI thread titles resilient to generation failures

## Why

Threads need a visible title while automatic generation is pending or fails. Hidden title-generation requests must also stay out of the foreground conversation, including during skill installation prompts.

## What changed

- Immediately display a Markdown-stripped, single-line excerpt of the first message, capped at 60 characters. Replace it with the generated title, or save the excerpt if generation fails or returns an invalid title.
- Give title threads explicit read-only permissions and request the `never` approval policy, subject to managed policy constraints. Keep blocking input requests on the hidden thread until timeout.
- Interrupt timed-out temporary structured turns before detaching them.

## Testing

Add coverage for provisional title replacement, fallback persistence, managed permission and approval policies, and hidden input requests. Add a terminal integration test that verifies title generation after choosing “Continue anyway” on a skill installation prompt.

prs.title: Deduplicate file search results from overlapping roots
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Deduplicate file search results from overlapping roots

## Why

Repeated or nested search roots can cause the same path to consume multiple result slots and inflate the total match count.

## What changed

Skip duplicate walk roots and deduplicate paths within overlapping subtrees before sending them to the matcher. Keep separate walks for nested roots so their ignore rules can still expose different entries.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering repeated parent and child roots in both orders, verifying that two distinct matching files fill a two-result limit and produce a total match count of two.

prs.title: Fix thread search snippets for whitespace-containing queries
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix thread search snippets for whitespace-containing queries

## Why

Normalizing whitespace before matching prevents thread search from producing snippets for queries containing repeated spaces, newlines, or tabs.

## What changed

Match against the original conversation text and select the surrounding excerpt before normalizing whitespace for display.

## Testing

Extend `thread_search_matches_json_escaped_content` to cover repeated spaces, newlines, and tabs alongside quotes and backslashes, and assert that the returned snippet has normalized whitespace.

prs.title: Enable incremental tool declarations by default for GCP
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Enable incremental tool declarations by default for GCP

## What changed

- Add the stable `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp` feature, enabled by default, to control incremental tool declarations on regular GCP Responses independently of Amazon Bedrock.
- Mark `incremental_tools_legacy` stable and keep it disabled by default for Amazon Bedrock.
- Expose the new flag in the configuration schema.

## Testing

Update integration coverage for GCP defaults and opt-out, independent provider flags, and incremental tool declarations during remote compaction.

prs.title: Protect MCP OAuth persistence from stale credential writes
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Protect MCP OAuth persistence from stale credential writes

## Why

A pending token refresh must not overwrite a newer login or recreate credentials after logout. Legacy file entries also need to retain their stored identity across refreshes.

## What changed

- Lock and revalidate stored credentials before persisting changed authorization-manager credentials, requiring authorization again if storage has changed.
- Update file-backed refreshes only when the matched entry still contains the expected credentials, preserving its key, server name, and ownership. Compare only fields the file format can persist.
- Remove matching legacy file entries when saving login credentials or deleting credentials, while preserving unrelated entries and profile-scoped enterprise credentials' separate local entries.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for newer logins and logout during pending persistence, repeated refreshes of legacy and escaped-name entries, and cleanup that preserves unrelated credentials. Update guard-retention and telemetry assertions for the validation path.

Fix Windows atomic writes and refresh build maintenance
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix Windows atomic writes and refresh build maintenance

## What changed

- Use `std::fs::rename` for atomic file replacement to support overlapping readers on Windows, retaining temporary-file cleanup if publication fails.
- Replace PowerShell fixtures in legacy sandbox capture and ConPTY lifecycle tests with native subprocesses. Keep child markers and output in writable workspaces, prevent inherited capture handles, and use asynchronous waits in ConPTY tests.
- Update the Bazel `rules_rs` Linux zlib package pins and mirrors.
- Temporarily exempt four `hickory-proto` advisories in `cargo-audit` and `cargo-deny`, with removal tied to upgrading Rust to 1.96+ and Rama to use `hickory-proto` 0.26.2 or later.

Fix code-mode session admission retries for proxy HTTP 503 responses
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix code-mode session admission retries for proxy HTTP 503 responses

## Why

Proxy HTTP 503 responses can contain plain-text or HTML bodies instead of gRPC frames. These responses should reach the existing session admission retry logic as `Unavailable` errors.

## What changed

Strip body data from HTTP 503 responses to `OpenSession`, preserving headers and trailers so tonic can honor an explicit gRPC status or infer `Unavailable` when none is present. Keep this handling scoped to session admission and retain the existing five-attempt retry limit.

## Testing

Extend admission tests to cover bounded retries for plain-text 503 responses, recovery after an HTML 503 response, and an explicit `Internal` gRPC status that prevents retries.

Fix pagination for unindexed threads sorted by ascending recency
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix pagination for unindexed threads sorted by ascending recency

## Why

Listing threads by ascending `recency_at` can omit `next_cursor` when rollout files have not yet been indexed in SQLite, preventing clients from fetching the remaining threads.

## What changed

Scan and index one extra rollout for ascending recency listings when SQLite is available, so the database can detect another page. Trim filesystem results to the requested page size for this sort order.

## Testing

Add a regression test that creates two unindexed rollouts after startup backfill and lists them with a provider filter and a page size of one. Verify both threads are returned in order, with a cursor only on the first page.

Fix fork parent metadata in reconstructed TUI sessions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix fork parent metadata in reconstructed TUI sessions

## Why

Reconstructing a thread session from the primary session could carry over another thread's fork parent and cached parent title.

## What changed

Use the target thread's `forked_from_id` when reconstructing sessions from `thread/read` responses and `ThreadStarted` notifications. Clear the cached parent title when the parent changes, and treat absent or invalid parent IDs as no parent.

## Testing

Extend the session reconstruction test to cover replacing an inherited fork parent and clearing inherited fork metadata for a thread with no parent, while retaining coverage of active permission settings.
